product.title: Key West Small-Group Sunset Sail with Wine and Hors d'oeuvres

description.text: Soak up sunset views from the water's edge, and admire a perspective many visitors miss, on this Key West sailing tour. Sample up to eight different wines and/or five different beers as you sail, and indulge in a selection of gourmet hors d'oeuvres to accompany them. As you go, learn more from your crew, and enjoy a festive and celebratory way to toast to your trip.Enjoy an experience many Key West visitors miss on this sunset cruise All snacks and beverages are included in the cost for your ease This tour is a great choice for romantic trips or special occasions Crew members are on hand to as Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
